releases.notes:
The types of messages that are disabled is as follows:

Default Chat Messages
Emote messages with /me
Private messages (receiving and sending) with /tell and /msg
Team messages with /teammsg
Say messages with /say

This is an experimental feature and will not run on Realms servers.

### **For the datapack release, download the .zip file**
### **For the mod release, download the .jar file**
